format: UCWDC post-event complaints (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Any complaint or challenge to a judging panel's composition or results must be made after the event and goes to the Judge Review Board.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must route post-event challenges to the Judge Review Board and not offer an in-event appeal that overrides results. DanceFlow's results correction workflow is organizer policy.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: UCWDC profile. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-23: 'done post-event and will go to the Judge Review Board'. BLOCKER for a UCWDC profile.
